svg.text: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 PIN USAGE (top view, USB connectors at the bottom)
U4 TPS2553 EN (high = phone VBUS on)
USB OTG D+ (host) to HEAD port
USB OTG D- (host) to HEAD port
Avoid: GPIO3/45/46 (straps), 35-37 (octal PSRAM on N16R8), 43/44 (UART0 console), 19/20 (taken by USB host).
* PSRAM pins used only on octal-PSRAM (R8) modules. RGB LED: GPIO48 on DevKitC-1 v1.0, GPIO38 on v1.1 - check the silkscreen.
